title: Unify loop_cut and coons_loop_cut into one handle-aware node
description: Collapse coons_loop_cut into loop_cut: if bundle has _bezier_handles_start slot, do de Casteljau subdivision (current coons_loop_cut behavior); otherwise straight cut (current loop_cut). Remove coons_loop_cut node id. Update all resources/dsl/*.dsl examples and any test DSLs.

testing-plan: 1. DSL with loop_cut on handled mesh produces same output as current coons_loop_cut. 2. DSL with loop_cut on plain mesh unchanged behavior.
